CLARITY BEFORE AND AFTER THE WORK

A proper scope.
A documented handover.

The details that help a committee or building manager understand what is proposed and what was done.

01

Agree the work.

The written scope sets out the proposed repair and the system, preparation, trades and access included in the project. Discuss the expected program, access restrictions and any existing reports before proceeding.

Explore the process
02

Keep the records.

Hydro-Tec’s handover approach includes photo evidence, quality assurance records and a professional handover pack for the building. Confirm the required project documentation in the agreed scope.

03

Understand
the warranty.

One coordinated crew provides one point of contact for the scope. Ask for the written warranty terms that apply to your project before agreeing to the work.

  • The applicable term and commencement date
  • The work and materials covered
  • Exclusions and maintenance responsibilities
  • The contact and process if an issue arises

Warranty duration and coverage need to be confirmed for the proposed work.
